labels.supported: The main static assertion is supported by supplied source/contracts and its linked evidence. Appropriate hypotheses and explicit limits are not treated as defects.
labels.partial: The main idea is plausible but essential qualifications, responsibility distinctions or linked evidence are incomplete/overbroad; the source does not establish the stronger assertion.
labels.contradicted: An explicit material assertion is inconsistent with the supplied source/contracts.
labels.undetermined: Source cannot establish the asserted intent, future behavior or runtime property. This is not problem-free.

protocol.metrics: Report each group's supported/partial/contradicted/undetermined counts and supported/all reviewed rate. Do not merge heterogeneous groups into a provider accuracy score. Evidence-span validity/hash checks are reported separately and do not prove semantics.
protocol.coverage: Derive essential source obligations separately; report omitted interpretation coverage without counting every unmentioned implementation detail as a false statement.
biases: Five authored examples and one selected external repository range
Not blind: reviewer knows Code Groove
LLM reviewer without independent human agreement
No execution or runtime behavior validation
protocol.hypothesis_scoring: Assess the evidence for the recorded status/disposition, not whether a rejected proposition is true. Open runtime hypotheses are undetermined, not errors.
protocol.event_scoring: Composite: meaning plus responsibility fit plus primary code navigation. Separately report content support so a span/role issue is not called a false meaning. Read linked full evidence for inputs/adjacent syntax; require missing central operations/conditions to be navigable.
